$comment: One entry per file in src/components. The registry build, the Storybook catalog and llms.txt all read this; the build fails if a component is missing.

badge.title: Badge
badge.description: A short label for status, category or count.

button.title: Button
button.description: Triggers an action or event with a single click.

chapter-scrubber.title: Chapter scrubber
chapter-scrubber.description: A rail of marks that swell under the pointer like the Dock, previewing the chapter at the crest.

checkbox.title: Checkbox
checkbox.description: Turns a single option on or off, or picks many from a list.

input.title: Input
input.description: A single line of free text.

integration-visual.title: Integration visual
integration-visual.description: A hub and the tools wired into it, with pulses along the routes.

label.title: Label
label.description: Names a form control and widens its hit area.

pixel-snail.title: Pixel snail
pixel-snail.description: A one-colour pixel snail that crawls on a loop while something loads.

reactions.title: Reactions
reactions.description: Lets people respond to content with an emoji in one tap.

textarea.title: Textarea
textarea.description: Several lines of free text that grow with the content.

token-flow.title: Token flow
token-flow.description: Walks a colour token from raw value to primitive to semantic role.
